falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured a V-bottom with no retest of lows; a break below 4950 (near the August 2024 low of ~4935) would violate the structural similarity and invalidate the 'bottom held' thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at ~28 and rapidly compress; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic escalation not present in the pattern, proving this is a different regime (likely distribution, not bottoming)

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40bps from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable-to-rising; a sharp flight-to-quality bid in bonds would signal recession/credit fear rather than the soft-landing reflation bottom the pattern suggests

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
